Dear [Admissions Committee/HR],  

I had the pleasure of working with Sana Patel during her capstone project at [University], where she developed a responsive patient portal for a local health nonprofit. As a professor specializing in human-computer interaction, I was struck by her ability to balance technical rigor with user-centered design.  

Sana’s expertise in React and TypeScript enabled her to build scalable, maintainable interfaces that met strict accessibility standards. During the project, she led the implementation of a custom state management solution using Redux, which reduced component re-renders by 40% and improved overall performance. Her commitment to WCAG guidelines ensured the portal was usable for patients with visual impairments, a detail that set her work apart.  

One standout moment came when she redesigned the portal’s dashboard to accommodate varying screen sizes. By integrating flexible grid systems and responsive typography, she improved usability across devices, resulting in a 25% increase in user engagement metrics. Her ability to iterate quickly and prioritize clarity under tight deadlines demonstrated exceptional work ethic and technical precision.  

Sana is a collaborative problem-solver who consistently balances innovation with practicality. Her contributions to this project reflected not only technical skill but also a deep understanding of how design impacts real-world outcomes.  

Please feel free to contact me for further details.  

Sincerely,  
[Professor’s Full Name]  
[University/Department]
